title: Custom Separators
description: Four trails that pass BreadcrumbSeparator props to the separator prop of each step after the first: $kind set to slash, chevron, or pipe, and $kind set to none with a dot in its children. Each step sets its own kind because the steps share no state. The chevron trail also sets $hoverOffset on its links, for a hover surface that suits an app header. Use it to match the mark to the surrounding design.
